passages.title: A hotel tests its new linen
body: The Norevka Hotel is evaluating tablecloths before replacing the stock in its dining rooms. Rather than judging samples straight from their packages, the housekeeping team is washing them repeatedly under the conditions used by the hotel's regular laundry service.
A cloth can look excellent when new but become too small for its intended table after several washes.

The purchasing manager says that consistency is as important as appearance. A tablecloth must extend beyond each edge of a table by the same intended amount. If the drop becomes too short, diners can see the legs and service fittings that the cloth was intended to conceal. The hotel measures each sample after it has dried fully and rested overnight.

Four suppliers provided plain white cloths without decorative borders. Their names were hidden from the staff doing the measurements. The purchasing office alone holds the correspondence linking supplier names to sample codes. That separation allows the housekeeping team to describe the samples without being influenced by previous experience with a vendor.

passages.title: Linen trial measurements
body: The table compares the same edge before and after ten washes. Measurements were taken with the same tape on the same worktable, and no sample was stretched. The staff checked the tape's starting mark before recording the figures.

The staff also recorded observations unrelated to size. L had the softest feel, M dried fastest, N resisted visible creasing best, and P required the least pressing time. These observations will appear in a separate section of the report so readers do not confuse them with the dimensional measurements.

The test table is 150 centimeters long. Cloths are placed with equal overhang at both ends. The staff recorded the total cloth length rather than measuring the overhang directly. All samples will remain in the housekeeping office until the purchasing meeting.

passages.title: Supplier correspondence
heading: To: Housekeeping team
From: Tavin Orle
Subject: Trial suppliers
body: I have checked the original envelopes. Sample L came from Delso Linen, M from Ivarni Cloth, N from Renka Weaving, and P from Solven Textiles. None of the suppliers has seen the other companies' measurements. They were each told only that the hotel was conducting a comparison.

For the first dining room, the manager is prioritizing the smallest reduction in length. The second dining room has not yet set its priorities. The manager also asked for the overhang produced by the cloth from Ivarni on our test table, using the measurements after ten washes.

Please do not return the samples yet. Our restaurant supervisor wants to feel the fabrics in person after tomorrow's breakfast service. She is especially interested in whether diners can move their glasses across the surface easily. I have arranged for her to visit housekeeping at ten thirty, when the measuring table will be clear.

body: 노레브카 호텔은 식당 리넨 교체 전에 일반 세탁 서비스 조건으로 여러 번 세탁해 시험한다.

passages.title: Leadership profiles for the annual report
body: Serlavi Foods will feature four employees in the people section of its annual report. The profiles are intended to show the range of decisions made across the company, not to list seniority or length of service. Each person will describe one recent project in ordinary language so that readers outside the business can understand the work.

The editor has assigned the food-development project to the opening profile, the purchasing project to the second, the distribution project to the third, and the financial-planning project to the closing profile. The layout places a portrait beside each story. The profiles will occupy four consecutive pages rather than appearing between the financial statements.

Interviewers should obtain permission to quote each employee and check any figures with the relevant department. They should not send a draft of one person's interview to another employee for approval. Each participant will review only the profile based on their own conversation. Final page proofs will be checked by the report editor.

passages.title: Interview assignments
body: The interview assignments are now confirmed. Dena is interviewing the employee who developed a reduced-salt soup. Orin is meeting the employee who changed how ingredient prices are negotiated. Vela is speaking with the employee who redesigned delivery rounds. Kelm is interviewing the employee who prepared the investment forecast for a new packing line.

The four interviewers have received the same general question list, but each may ask follow-up questions relevant to the project. Sessions are expected to take forty minutes. Audio recordings will be kept in the report team's restricted folder until the participants have checked the written profiles.

Photographs will be taken on a separate day. The photographer needs the interviewers to provide a brief description of each project so the portraits can be made in suitable work settings. A neutral office background is available for any participant whose normal work area is unsuitable.

passages.title: A wholesaler measures seasonal demand
body: Kelvori Beverage Supply used to compare monthly order totals directly. That approach made short months appear weaker even when customers ordered at the same daily rate. The sales team now reports both the total number of cases ordered and the average per trading day. A month with fewer trading days can have a lower total but a stronger daily rate.

The new report is not a measure of profit. It does not include selling prices, delivery costs, or discounts. Its purpose is to help the warehouse plan the flow of cases through the building. Buyers still examine individual products when deciding what to reorder from manufacturers. The company divides its customer base into four regions. Each region follows the same trading calendar, although their order volumes differ. Seasonal promotions are arranged locally. Managers are asked to describe any unusual local event alongside their numbers rather than assume that every change reflects a general market trend.

passages.title: Regional orders: comparison
body: Cases ordered in April and May, respectively: North region 2,000 and 2,090; East region 1,600 and 1,980; South region 4,000 and 4,400; West region 1,800 and 1,760. These figures include all orders accepted during each month, regardless of the later delivery date.

The figures were prepared by the sales office, not the warehouse. Returned cases are reported separately and are not deducted here. No regional boundary changed between the months, so each pair of figures covers the same customer group.

Local promotion notes: North ran a sports-club offer; East supplied a new outdoor concert series; South distributed sample packs to existing cafés; West tested a smaller minimum order. The notes describe activity rather than estimating how many additional orders it caused.

passages.title: Preparing the warehouse briefing
heading: To: Sales analyst
From: Rina Ostel
Subject: Warehouse briefing
body: April had twenty trading days and May had twenty-two. For tomorrow's briefing, I need the region with the largest increase in cases per trading day, not the largest rise in the monthly total. Please use the comparison prepared by Sales. The warehouse supervisors will use the result when discussing where to assign additional picking staff.

I also need a short note about the region whose daily average stayed exactly the same between April and May. Please identify the local activity listed for that region, but do not claim that the activity caused the result. We have not compared participating customers with customers who did not participate.

The briefing will begin at nine in the warehouse office. Bring the figures on paper because the projector is being used for a safety session elsewhere. I have reserved twenty minutes for the order discussion and another ten for questions from the supervisors. No purchasing decisions will be made during this meeting.

body: 켈보리 음료 도매는 월 총 주문만 비교해 짧은 달이 약하게 보이곤 했다. 이제 총 케이스와 영업일당 평균을 함께 보고한다. 영업일이 적으면 총량이 낮아도 일평균이 높을 수 있다.
이는 이익 지표가 아니며 가격·배송비·할인을 포함하지 않는다. 창고 흐름을 계획하는 목적이다. 제조사 재주문 때는 개별 상품도 살핀다. 고객은 네 지역으로 나누며 같은 영업 달력을 쓰나 물량은 다르다. 판촉은 지역별이다. 모든 변화를 시장 추세로 보지 않도록 특이 지역 사건을 수치와 함께 설명한다.

heading: 수신: 영업 분석 담당자
발신: 리나 오스텔
제목: 창고 브리핑
body: 4월 영업일은 20일, 5월은 22일입니다. 내일 브리핑에는 월 총량이 아니라 영업일당 케이스 증가가 가장 큰 지역이 필요합니다. 영업실 자료를 사용해 주십시오. 창고 감독자들이 추가 집품 직원을 어디에 배치할지 논의합니다.
4·5월 일평균이 정확히 같은 지역의 지역 활동도 짧게 적어 주십시오. 그 활동이 결과를 일으켰다고 주장하지는 마십시오. 참여·비참여 고객 비교는 하지 않았습니다.
9시 창고 사무실에서 시작합니다. 프로젝터는 다른 안전 교육에 쓰니 종이 자료를 가져오십시오. 주문 논의20분, 질문10분이며 구매 결정은 하지 않습니다.

questions.explain: 기사는 창고 내 케이스 흐름 계획이 목적이며 이익 측정은 아니라고 한다.

questions.q: Which region should be highlighted for the largest daily increase?

ko.q: 일평균 증가가 가장 큰 지역으로 어디를 강조해야 하는가?

questions.explain: 지역표와 메일의 영업일 수를 결합하면 North100→95, East80→90, South200→200, West90→80이다. 일평균은 East가 10으로 가장 많이 늘지만 월 총량 증가는 South의 400이 더 크므로 월 총량만으로 고르면 틀린다.

questions.q: Which activity belongs in the note about an unchanged daily average?

ko.q: 일평균이 변하지 않은 지역 메모에는 어느 활동이 들어가는가?

questions.explain: 메일이 요청한 동일 일평균 지역은 South이며 4000/20=4400/22=200이다. 지역 활동 기록에서 South는 기존 카페 견본 팩 제공과 연결된다.

questions.q: Why should attendees bring printed figures?

ko.q: 참석자가 인쇄 수치를 가져와야 하는 이유는 무엇인가?

questions.explain: 메일 마지막 문단은 프로젝터가 다른 안전 교육에 쓰인다고 한다.
